title: Finance Operations Analyst
description:
InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in more than 30 countries. As pioneers in the gift card space, we hold two-thirds of the global market share. Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.

We are currently seeking a Finance Operations Analyst to join our team in Brazil. This role is ideal for professionals with a strong technical and financial background, excellent attention to detail, and a passion for data-driven operations.

Note: Fluent or advanced English is required for daily communication with international teams.

About the Role

As a Finance Operations Analyst, you will be responsible for driving operational efficiencies related to customer and product pricing information within InComm’s Financial Information Systems. You will apply your understanding of the prepaid business, technical expertise, and strong communication skills to foster collaboration across teams involved in delivering our services globally.

You will work closely with Domestic and International Retail Sales, Product Account Management, and technical teams responsible for pricing, billing, invoicing, settlement, and reconciliation. This role also supports the Analyst II position and contributes to improving pricing and billing processes, ensuring client and channel satisfaction.

You will be expected to study enterprise data stewardship across multiple channels and platforms, review project and business requirements, and communicate effectively across internal and functional groups to ensure timely and accurate project delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Provide concise weekly status reports for assigned activities
  • Promote idea generation and collaboration sessions with internal teams
  • Follow processes and protocols for data enrichment technologies
  • Communicate data requirements to internal counterparts and customers
  • Share process changes with cross-functional teams
  • Escalate data inconsistencies promptly to avoid urgent issues
  • Track and log issues for retrospectives and suggest process improvements
  • Manage time effectively, prioritize tasks, and handle multiple assignments
  • Enforce workflows and business rules to improve data quality and delivery time
  • Enforce SLAs for Finance Data Administration tasks
  • Troubleshoot data-related incidents
  • Research and document rules for secure protocols and data integrity
  • Perform other tasks and responsibilities as assigned

Skills and Attributes

  • Self-directed and proactive
  • Decisive problem solver
  • Ability to influence others
  • Forward-thinking and adaptable
  • Strong business acumen and technical background
  • Effective time management and organizational skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • Ability to multitask and work collaboratively

Experience and Education

  • 1+ years of experience in the prepaid product industry, preferably with exposure to Finance, Accounting, or Data Management
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence decisions
  • Ability to work cooperatively and effectively with others to set goals and resolve problems
  • Solid technical background with the ability to learn new platforms and apply knowledge to operational practices
  • Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to take initiative
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments with cross-functional teams
  • Excellent communication skills, including confidence in presenting to executive leadership
  • Ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical audiences
  • Bachelor’s or Associate’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Accounting, Finance, or related fields preferred
  • CPM or PMP certification is a plus, but not required

This role involves working with financial data and system configurations, supporting billing migrations, and ensuring accurate invoice generation. Candidates should be inquisitive, data-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple tasks in a dynamic environment.

title: Senior Loan Closer
description:
Sobre Verde Credit

A Verde Credit é uma fintech inovadora e líder no mercado de soluções financeiras, especializada em fornecer capital de giro e adiantamentos de recebíveis (Merchant Cash Advance – MCA) para pequenas e médias empresas nos Estados Unidos. Nossa missão é empoderar negócios, oferecendo acesso rápido e desburocratizado a recursos financeiros essenciais para o seu crescimento. Valorizamos a proatividade, a excelência no atendimento ao cliente e a busca contínua por resultados, em um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e flexível.

Resumo da posição

A Verde Credit busca um Senior Loan Closer para liderar negociações de alto valor, atuar como referência técnica para o time comercial e contribuir diretamente com a estratégia de crescimento. Esta posição exige domínio de vendas complexas consultivas, visão analítica, senioridade em gestão de stakeholders e forte atuação como mentor de perfis mais juniores.

Responsabilidades principais

  • Fechar operações mid/large ticket com merchants e grandes canais (ISOs/brokers), alinhando risco, pricing e termos (factor rate, holdback/retrieval rate, split/ACH, prazo, early payoff).
  • Liderar conversas em múltiplos stakeholders (owner/C-level, ISO principal, underwriting/risk, legal).

Soluções customizadas orientadas a valor

  • Cocarriar com o cliente a modelagem da oferta: estrutura, cronograma de desembolso, cadência de remessas (daily/weekly), covenants operacionais e critérios de elegibilidade.
  • Navegar objeções complexas (custo efetivo, sazonalidade, stacking policy, fluxo de caixa) com business case claro.

Gestão de pipeline avançada e forecast

  • Operar um pipeline robusto de deals complexos, com precisão de forecast, milestones definidos e higiene exemplar de CRM.
  • Acelerar ciclos via priorização de “probabilidade x impacto”, SLAs com ISOs e controle de stips/documentação.

Mentoria e coaching

  • Atuar como referência técnica para Closer I: shadowing, debriefs, role plays, revisão de propostas e estratégia de negociação.
  • Padronizar playbooks, melhores práticas e materiais de objeções.

Contribuição estratégica e inteligência de mercado

  • Alimentar produto, risco e marketing com insights (setores, tíquetes, performance por canal, concorrência, tendências regulatórias).
  • Propor melhorias de processo (desde intake/submission até funding e pós-venda) para ganho de velocidade e taxa de conversão.

Relacionamento pós-venda estratégico

  • Cultivar carteira de clientes-chave e ISOs para renovações (renewals), consolidações, up-sell e cross-sell (ex.: acessórias de capital).
  • Monitorar saúde do merchant e elegibilidade para novas originações.

Alinhamento com underwriting, risco e compliance

  • Trabalhar junto a risk/underwriting na análise de bank statements, NSFs, negative days, seasonality, TIB, monthly gross, UCCs/liens, chargebacks.
  • Zelar por KYC/KYB, políticas de conduta com ISOs e boas práticas de transparência.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Negociação de alto nível em MCA (EUA): experiência comprovada fechando operações consultivas complexas com merchants e/ou via ISOs/brokers.
  • Ser fluente em Português, Espanhol e Inglês
  • Pensamento estratégico: leitura de cenário do cliente, do canal e do mercado para arquitetar abordagens vencedoras.
  • Relacionamento sênior: construção de confiança em nível executivo (owners/C-level) e em canais (ISOs principais).
  • Liderança e mentoria: capacidade de elevar a régua do time, formar Closer I e difundir melhores práticas.
  • Análise de dados avançada: interpretar métricas de pipeline, win-rate por canal, cohort de renovações, LTV/CAC, acurácia de forecast.
  • Adaptabilidade e resolução de problemas complexos: lidar com objeções difíceis, prazos apertados, múltiplos decisores e cenários dinâmicos.
  • Conhecimento de mercado/produto: domínio dos mecanismos de MCA, integrações de split/processor, impactos de stacking e práticas do ecossistema.
  • Ferramentas: proficiência em CRM , Sales Navigator, e ferramentas de produtividade; familiaridade com checklists de stips e docusign.

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Track record com renewals e expansão de carteira (up-sell/cross-sell) em MCA.
  • Experiência colaborando com underwriting/risk e leitura de bank statements.
  • Networking ativo com ISOs de alta performance.
  • Experiência em padronizar playbooks e treinar times de venda.

O que oferecemos

  • Remuneração competitiva: salário base atrativo e comissão agressiva sobre fechamentos gerados e convertidos; potencial de ganhos acima da base conforme performance.
  • Onboarding e treinamento: trilha estruturada de ramp-up, roteiros, playbooks, coaching 1:1 e simulações de calls.
  • Desenvolvimento profissional: plano de crescimento com possibilidade de evoluir para SDR Pleno, AE ou outras trilhas comerciais.
  • Cultura dinâmica: ambiente colaborativo, desafiador, com metas claras e reconhecimento por resultados.

Processo seletivo

  1. Inscrição e triagem de currículos.
  2. Teste rápido de proficiência no par de idiomas escolhido (Português + Inglês ou Português + Espanhol).
  3. Entrevista com direção de vendas

title: Consultor(a) Tax (Compensações Fiscais)
description:
Quem é a Advizo?

A Advizo é uma consultoria tributária em plena expansão, dedicada a transformar a complexidade fiscal em resultados concretos e valor para seus clientes. Nosso DNA é marcado pela inovação e pelo investimento constante em tecnologia e processos de ponta para otimizar a gestão tributária. Em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e de crescimento acelerado, acreditamos que o sucesso da empresa está diretamente ligado ao desenvolvimento de nossos talentos. Aqui, você não apenas fará parte de uma equipe, mas será um agente fundamental na construção do nosso futuro.

Uma oportunidade única de crescimento profissional

Estamos em busca de um(a)  Consultor(a) de Compensação Fiscal , profissional da área fiscal/contábil ou tributária responsável por analisar dados, executar processos e garantir a excelência técnica na operacionalização das compensações.

Este é um papel essencial para transformar oportunidades tributárias em resultados concretos para nossos clientes, assegurando conformidade, precisão e agilidade.

Qual o papel deste profissional?

A compensação fiscal é uma das atividades mais estratégicas em consultoria tributária, sendo responsável por converter oportunidades fiscais em benefícios tangíveis para nossos clientes. Enquanto outras consultorias executam estas atividades de forma dispersa, a Advizo está investindo na criação de uma área dedicada, reconhecendo que esta especialização trará ganhos significativos em eficiência, padronização e qualidade.

Como Consultor desta área, esperaremos que você:

  • Analise dados contábeis e fiscais para identificar créditos tributários elegíveis para compensação;
  • Prepare e revise pedidos de compensação e ressarcimento junto à Receita Federal (PER/DCOMP, PER/DCOMP Web);
  • Execute retificações de obrigações acessórias , como DCTF, DCTF-Web, ECF, EFD-Contribuições e EFD-ICMS/IPI;
  • Valide informações nos sistemas da Receita Federal (e-CAC) e acompanhar tramitações de processos administrativos;
  • Apoie o gerente da área na implementação de fluxos de trabalho, automações e controles de qualidade;
  • Gere relatórios de acompanhamento de compensações, créditos utilizados e créditos em trânsito;
  • Assegure conformidade técnica com a legislação tributária vigente e colaborar em projetos de melhoria contínua.

Por que você?

Requisitos essenciais:

  1. Experiência sólida : Mínimo de 5 anos em consultoria tributária (com foco em tributos diretos ou indiretos), tendo atuado em São Paulo em uma das seguintes empresas: EY, Deloitte, KPMG, PwC, Alvarez & Marsal, Martinelli Advogados ou LacLaw.

Expertise técnica : 

  1. Conhecimento do ambiente e-CAC e validadores de obrigações fiscais;
  2. Experiência em retificações de obrigações acessórias (DCTF, DCTF-Web, ECF, EFD-ICMS/IPI e/ou EFD-Contribuições); e
  3. Familiaridade com a elaboração de pedidos de compensação e ressarcimento.

Formação acadêmica : Graduação ou pós-graduação em Contabilidade, Direito e Administração.

Competências comportamentais : 

  1. Excelente capacidade de organização para gerenciar múltiplos projetos e clientes simultaneamente;
  2. Comunicação verbal e escrita impecáveis; e
  3. Perfil colaborativo e orientado a resultados.

Diferenciais competitivos:

  1. Gestão moderna : Conhecimento em BPMN, gestão de projetos e uso de ferramentas como Monday ou Notion;

O que oferecemos

Na Advizo, acreditamos que nosso crescimento está diretamente ligado ao desenvolvimento de nossos talentos. Por isso, oferecemos:

Remuneração e benefícios atrativos:

  • Pacote de remuneração:  Remuneração + bônus semestrais acima do mercado, baseado em critérios objetivos incluindo faturamento da empresa, produtividade individual, comissões sobre vendas, abertura de parcerias comerciais, indicação de novos talentos e desenvolvimento de novos produtos/linhas de serviços;
  • Plano de saúde : Plano de saúde com cobertura nacional de primeira linha.

Flexibilidade e qualidade de vida:

  • Modelo híbrido : Presença flexível no escritório, equilibrando colaboração presencial com trabalho remoto.

Desenvolvimento profissional acelerado:

  • Plano de carreira estruturado : Oportunidades reais e rápidas de crescimento em uma empresa em expansão;
  • Investimento em conhecimento : Subsídios para participação em congressos tributários e Financiamento de cursos de extensão e pós-graduação.
  • Protagonismo : Oportunidade única de auxiliar na construção de área estratégica desde o início.

Gostou do Desafio?

Se você quer construir algo novo, deixar sua marca e crescer junto com uma consultoria que não para de inovar, queremos conhecer você! Mande seu CV para nós!

description:
About SleekFlow

Join SleekFlow, a thriving SaaS startup that is experiencing rapid growth globally thanks to the support of renowned investors like Alibaba Entrepreneurs Fund and Tiger Global. Our mission is to develop the next generation of Conversational AI, empowering customer interactions across all channels—from messaging to voice—and enhancing business workflows and processes.

At SleekFlow, we have developed an all-in-one Omnichannel Conversation AI Suite that drives conversions through conversations. Our platform seamlessly integrates with popular channels such as WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, WeChat, and more, providing comprehensive communication solutions. With our AI customer engagement platform, enterprises can automate growth by enhancing productivity across their sales, marketing, and support teams.

As we aggressively expand into emerging markets, we seek adventurous, diverse, and passionate individuals to join us on this exciting journey. Join our team and grow your career with SleekFlow!

Associate Level

Contract type: Contractor

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Prior Experience in SaaS/ Software Industry is preferred

Language: Business-level fluency in English

Role

As a Customer Support Specialist at SleekFlow, you will provide direct customer support via phone, email and chat to existing customers. You will work with the sales and support team to troubleshoot customer issues and ensure the best possible customer experience. You work at the front lines, providing real-time assistance to clients in need. Customer experience pain points you identify will inform product improvements and allow SleekFlow to optimize the platform for customers worldwide.

Responsibilities

  • Complete a comprehensive training program to prepare for responding to live customer issues.
  • Handle incoming enquiries via emails, calls and chats in a professional manner.
  • Use your deep SleekFlow product knowledge to resolve client-related issues.
  • Communicate with Product, Sales and Marketing teams to convey client feedback and sentiments.

  • Work continuously to document the details of each interaction in order to easily research customer issues and to inform product improvements

Skills and Qualifications

  • Fluent in English & Portuguese with Spanish being useful
  • Prior experience with CRM preferred
  • Ability to learn, adapt and thrive quickly in a dynamic environment
  • Comfortable to engage with a diverse array of customers
  • Problem solving and critical thinking with detail oriented
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills (written & verbal)
  • Strong customer obsession attitude with evidence of taking independent and appropriate decisions for the customer
  • Strong computer skills, including CRM, Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel.
  • Team player with the desire to try new ideas in order to achieve greater levels of success

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate.

SleekFlow is a place where everyone can grow. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

title: CRC/CSM/SDR
description:
Vaga: Especialista em Relacionamento com Pacientes e Captação de Clientes - Clínica Odontológica Castell (SDR/CRC)

A  Clínica Castell , reconhecida por sua excelência no cuidado com a saúde bucal há 40 anos, está em busca de talentos para compor nossa equipe! Se você é comunicativo, organizado e possui habilidade para engajar e fidelizar pacientes, essa oportunidade é para você! ✨

 OBJETIVO DO CARGO

  • Engajar Pacientes : Manter pacientes cadastrados conectados com a clínica, incentivando consultas preventivas e tratamentos adicionais.
  • Captar Novos Clientes : Trabalhar com leads inbound das campanhas de marketing e transformá-los em pacientes ativos.

 PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

Contato e Relacionamento com Pacientes (SDR/CRC):

  1. Planejamento diário :
  • Analisar históricos clínicos e pendências de pacientes.
  • Preparar conteúdos informativos e educativos para suportar os contatos.
  1. Engajamento personalizado :
  • Realizar ligações, enviar mensagens de WhatsApp ou e-mails personalizados.
  • Argumentar sobre a importância de consultas preventivas e tratamentos.
  • Gerenciar objeções (tempo, custo ou necessidade), oferecendo soluções práticas.
  1. Agendamentos :
  • Concretizar consultas diretamente nos sistemas da clínica.
  • Priorizar pacientes com maior necessidade e organizar a agenda.
  1. Atualização e relatórios :
  • Registrar contatos e resultados no sistema interno.
  • Participar de reuniões semanais para ajustar estratégias, com foco na fidelização.

Captação e Conversão de Leads (Inbound):

  1. Primeiro contato rápido :
  • Abordar leads recebidos de campanhas (Instagram, Facebook, Google Ads, entre outros).
  • Realizar perguntas qualificadoras para entender a necessidade de cada lead.
  1. Integração com Marketing :
  • Participar do alinhamento estratégico com o gestor de tráfego e social media.
  • Oferecer feedbacks sobre a qualidade dos leads e melhorar campanhas.
  1. Manutenção do relacionamento :
  • Criar sequências de follow-up (automáticas e personalizadas) para leads não convertidos.
  • Compartilhar materiais explicativos sobre os tratamentos odontológicos oferecidos.
  1. Otimização contínua :
  • Analisar landing pages e formulários da clínica com o time de web design, sugerindo melhorias.

 INDICADORES DE DESEMPENHO (KPIs)

  • Taxa de Contato Realizado : Engajar ao menos 65% da lista de pacientes mensal.
  • Taxa de Conversão : Garantir que 30% dos leads agendem consultas.
  • Taxa de Comparecimento : Trabalhar para que 80% dos pacientes agendados compareçam.
  • Satisfação : Garantir que os pacientes tenham uma excelente experiência de atendimento!

 PERFIL DO CANDIDATO IDEAL

  • Habilidades essenciais :
  • Comunicação clara, persuasiva e acolhedora.
  • Organização para lidar com diferentes sistemas de gestão (CRM) e otimizar processos.
  • Proatividade para superar objeções e converter pacientes hesitantes.
  • Experiência desejável :
  • Relacionamento com cliente, vendas ou atendimento (preferencialmente na área de saúde).
  • Vivência em captação de leads inbound será considerada um diferencial!
  • Competências técnicas :
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas digitais (WhatsApp Business, CRM, Excel).
  • Capacidade de interpretar dados e gerar relatórios analíticos.
  • Perfil comportamental :
  • Foco no cliente, empatia e resiliência.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com o time de Marketing.
  • Persistência

 O QUE OFERECEMOS?

  • Ambiente inovador e focado na excelência odontológica.
  • Treinamento contínuo sobre tratamentos, ferramentas e técnicas de abordagem.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma clínica em expansão.
  • Pacote de benefícios e incentivos especiais para metas alcançadas.
  • Após período de treinamento e adaptação variável entre 30 a 60 dias, regime híbrido 

Como se candidatar?

Interessados devem enviar currículo pelo LinkedIn ou enviar uma mensagem com o título "Candidatura SDR/CRC/CMS Castell" . ⚡

✨ Junte-se a nós e faça parte de um time que transforma sorrisos e vidas!

Collaborating closely with marketing designers embedded across business units, you’ll maintain and evolve Turing’s visual identity, leveraging the latest creative tools and staying ahead of design trends to deliver exceptional brand experiences.

  • Strong working knowledge of presentation tools (Google Slides and PowerPoint). Deep understanding of master slides, theme building, and layout systems in both platforms.
  • Experience leveraging generative AI tools for design (e.g., Midjourney, Runway, Adobe Firefly) to enhance creative output and efficiency.
  • Strong understanding of branding, visual storytelling, and integrated marketing principles.
  • Demonstrated experience with design systems, brand guidelines, and visual identity management across diverse channels.
  • Excellent collaboration, organizational, and communication skills, able to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Self-motivated, proactive learner comfortable working remotely in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Proven experience designing client-facing presentations, such as pitch decks and sales materials, with a focus on clear visual storytelling, data visualization, and adherence to brand standards.

title: Partnership Sales Manager (Commercial Real Estate)
description:
We are looking for a Partnership Sales Manager for an opportunity in Recife!

Our client is the largest provider of flexible workspace solutions in the world. Trading under a number of brands they have a physical network of over 3,000 locations across 1,000 towns and cities in 120 countries. Our partner's mission is to help millions of customers to have a great day at work, every day.

COVID-19 forced an unprecedented experiment in flexible working, which is now driving a surge in demand for our flexible workspace solutions. To meet this demand, they are rapidly accelerating the growth of the global network. To deliver our client's ambition they are recruiting partners to open and operate locations. Their target audience is building owners, franchise operators, and competitors, we will work with partners under a variety of commercial structures demanding a dynamic and broad-based approach to business development.

So what would be your role and purpose?

  • You will play a critical role in selling and developing business partnerships at local, and regional levels across the country.
  • You will be proactive and passionate, capable of creating your own sales leads as well as rapidly converting centrally-driven inquiries.
  • Success for the Partnership Sales Manager will open up opportunities across the wider business of the company with the potential to move into general, cross-function, and international roles.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Delivering around 10 new partner locations every year
  • Generating awareness and visibility of the partnership proposition in the market by developing B2B connections.
  • Identifying contacting and pitching prospective partners through a range of BD activities including networking, local canvassing, and cold-calling.
  • Sourcing partners capable of delivering rapid growth of our network through conversion of existing buildings or by quickly securing new buildings.
  • Selling the range of partnership solutions to all prospects, converting interest into commercial negotiations, and securing board approval for new partnership deals.
  • Converting commercial discussions into signed contracts with the support of the legal team.
  • Spending a significant amount of time in the field, generating leads, meeting customers, and closing deals.

Required Skills, Experience & Qualifications:

  • Sales and/or B2B business development experience in a fast-growing, dynamic business
  • Self-starters are used to self-generating interest and focus relentlessly on delivering results.
  • Proven ability to find & convert deals quickly with tenacity and dedication
  • Demonstrable track record of sourcing & delivering, at pace, multiple deals of a meaningful scale (£250k+ investment)
  • Self-sufficient, deal-focused, and can-do mindset, willing to take risks to succeed.
  • Outstanding communications skills and the ability to present a compelling narrative to a wide variety of audiences, both large & small.
  • Able to work under pressure and to think independently to create interest in a proposition.
  • Strong business and financial acumen to give others confidence & to give credibility in the selling process.

Do you get an adrenaline rush from owning a full sales cycle, cold outreach, and working in a fast-paced environment? Do not wait any longer and send your application in!

title: LehrerIn für die Grundschule
description:
Stellenausschreibung

Deutsche Ortslehrkraft (DOLK) für die Grundschule

Colégio Visconde de Porto Seguro, Deutsche Schule São Paulo, Brasilien

Stellenanbieter: Colégio Visconde de Porto Seguro

Kennziffer: GS2026

Bewerbungsfrist:

Tätigkeitsbeginn: ab 02/2026

Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit // Anstellungsdauer: 2 Jahre, dann unbefristet

Laufbahn: Ortslehrkraft

Ort: São Paulo, Brasilien

Tätigkeitsprofil

Das Colégio Visconde de Porto Seguro ist eine deutsche Auslandsschule, deren Abschlüsse von der KMK in Deutschland anerkannt werden. Die Schule wird von der Bundesrepublik Deutschland als Begegnungsschule gefördert und ist von der Ständigen Konferenz der Kultusminister (KMK) zur Abhaltung von Prüfungen der allgemeinen deutschen Hochschulreife (Abitur) ermächtigt. Mit zwei aufeinander abgestimmten Bildungsplänen sind sowohl deutsche als auch brasilianischen Abschlüsse anerkannt und möglich.

Unsere freundlichen und sehr motivierten Schülerinnen und Schüler kennen und lernen in zwei Kulturkreisen und das bereits vom Kindergarten an. Auf diese Weise bekommen sie erweiterte Kenntnisse über Werte, Normen, Geschichte und Mentalität eines anderen Landes vermittelt.

Angeboten wird eine Stelle in Vollzeit. Das Deputat umfasst 28 Stunden pro Unterrichtswoche. Neben der unterrichtlichen Tätigkeit ist die Bereitschaft zur Mitarbeit in schulischen Gremien sowie Engagement bei außerunterrichtlichen Veranstaltungen ausdrücklich erwünscht.

Die Tätigkeit umfasst:

Klassenleitung

Fachunterricht in den Klassenstufen 1 bis 4

Mitarbeit in der Unterrichts‐ und Schulentwicklung

Teilnahme an Dienstbesprechungen und Konferenzen

Anforderungsprofil

Gesucht werden ab sofort (bzw. zu den Terminen 02/2025 und 08/2025) Lehrkräfte, die Freude haben am pädagogischen Umgang mit Kindern und über Sozialkompetenz, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und freundliches Auftreten verfügen. Erforderlich sind hohe Flexibilität, Aufgeschlossenheit, Motivation sowie Teamfähigkeit und ein starkes Interesse am kulturellen Umfeld (Brasilien/Südamerika).

Die Beherrschung der Landessprache (Portugiesisch) ist keine Einstellungsvoraussetzung, jedoch wird das Erlernen dieser während des Arbeitsverhältnisses begrüßt und gefördert. Folgende Anforderungen sollten Sie erfüllen:

sonderpädagogische Ausbildung bzw. Lehrbefähigung für die Primarstufe bzw. für die SEKI 

Bewerber(innen) müssen über das 1. und 2. Staatsexamen (Lehramt) oder einen vergleichbaren Abschluss verfügen, Erfahrungen und Sicherheit im Umgang mit digitalen Medien als Unterrichtswerkzeug (z.B. TEAMS) überdurchschnittliche Einsatzbereitschaft, Neugier und Arbeitsfreude, Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität, Belastbarkeit.

Sie erwartet ein hochinteressantes Arbeitsumfeld in einem motivierten, netten Team.

Die Vergütung erfolgt nach der für die Schule gültigen Gehaltsrichtlinie und liegt im Landesvergleich weit über dem Durschnitt. Weitere Zusatzleistungen wie Krankenversicherung, Lebensversicherung, Mietzuschuss kommen hinzu. Bei Zuzug aus dem Ausland erhalten Sie eine Umzugspauschale sowie eine Flugkostenpauschale.

title: Global Brand Director
description:
We're looking for a strategic, creative and results-oriented leader to join our team and drive the Brand strategy and campaign team. Telling a compelling, unique brand story consistently and efficiently around the globe is at the heart of your work. You will help transform this iconic brand into an emotionally engaged relevant 21st-century brand leader through your unparalleled ability to organize and manage projects at a fast pace while multi-tasking, your knowledge of a social first marketing landscape and your innate passion for inclusivity and purpose-forward brand building. You’ll engage cross-functional disciplines to launch award-winning brand campaigns and communications. Ultimately, the objectives are to ensure the brand is up to speed and leading in a fast-changing digital world and that it is set up to lead in the future. Throughout this, you will be encouraged to bring fresh thinking to shake up the way we do things with a test-and-learn approach. As the head of Brand you will be fully responsible for defining, developing, and implementing the brand strategy.

About the Role:

  • Applies consumer insights and market intelligence to the process of developing approaches to linking a brand identity to the company and its products.
  • Develops and nurtures relationships with business leaders and regions to understand their market needs, country strategies and insights, then links brand positioning to maximize customer loyalty and connection to the product and company.
  • Uses excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal and management skills to interact with staff, colleagues, senior leadership, media and cross-functional teams.
  • Partners with cross-functional teams to lead brand planning efforts and develop brand personality.
  • Develops brand guidelines, then drives brand training and governance to ensure the organization is properly implementing the brand strategy.
  • Achieves results in a fast-moving, dynamic environment. Consumer-centric, exhibiting dynamic, motivated, and results-oriented creative thinking.
  • Direct development of programs that establish and nurture a strong marketing community across marketing disciplines, holding reviews with senior leaders & stakeholders and global partners to deliver the global brand strategy.

Responsibilities:

  • Define, develop, and implement the brand strategy.
  • Apply consumer insights and market intelligence.
  • Develop and nurture relationships with business leaders and regions.
  • Use excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal and management skills.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to lead brand planning efforts.
  • Develop brand guidelines and drive brand training and governance.
  • Achieve results in a fast-moving, dynamic environment.
  • Direct development of programs that establish and nurture a strong marketing community.

Qualifications:

  • Degree in Business-related discipline.
  • 15+ years of related experience.

Required Skills:

  • Results-oriented with an exceptional track record of developing profitable engagement marketing programs.

Preferred Skills:

  • Strong leadership skills and a proven ability to manage, mentor, and develop high-performing and highly engaged teams.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit and ability to work independently.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for delighting and advocating for customers.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
DevOps Sênior | PJ | 100% Remoto

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) DevOps Sênior para se juntar ao nosso time em um projeto desafiador e de grande escala.

Se você é apaixonado(a) por automação, infraestrutura como código (IaC) e pelo ecossistema Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , essa vaga é para você. A sua missão será construir, escalar e garantir a confiabilidade de uma infraestrutura cloud-native de ponta.

Suas principais responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar e evoluir uma infraestrutura robusta e escalável em GCP (GKE, Cloud Run, IAM, VPC).
  • Desenvolver e manter a automação da infraestrutura com Terraform (IaC) .
  • Orquestrar aplicações em containers com Docker e Kubernetes (GKE) .
  • Implementar e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD utilizando Azure DevOps .
  • Garantir a saúde e a performance dos sistemas através de ferramentas de observabilidade ( Prometheus, Grafana, Cloud Monitoring ).
  • Aplicar as melhores práticas de segurança em nuvem, protegendo nosso ambiente contra ameaças.
  • Atuar na resolução de problemas complexos e otimização de performance.

O que buscamos (Requisitos Essenciais):

  • Sólida experiência com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) .
  • Proficiência em Terraform para infraestrutura como código.
  • Domínio de Docker e Kubernetes (GKE) .
  • Experiência prática com pipelines CI/CD no Azure DevOps .
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, etc.).
  • Forte capacidade analítica para troubleshooting e otimização.

O que te destaca (Diferenciais):

  • Certificações GCP (Professional DevOps Engineer, Cloud Architect).
  • Experiência com arquitetura Serverless (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions).
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Redes e Segurança Cloud (VPC, Firewalls, IAM).
  • Vivência com cultura SRE (SLOs/SLIs).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados gerenciados (Cloud SQL, Firestore) e API Gateways (Apigee, Kong).

title: Assistente de Bibliotecário (Biblioteca Instituicional)
description:

title: UX Designer/ UX Lead (Brazil/Argentina)
description:
Role: UX Lead (Brazil/Argentina)

Organization: This role will report to the Associate Director of Human-Centered Design at Client.

Required Experience & Skills:

• A UX Designer with 8-10 years of hands-on experience leading UX research and design initiatives.

• A passion for creating human-centered designs to solve the right problems for both – the users and the business teams.

• Deep understanding and knowledge of Human-Centered Design, UX Research, and Design Processes, standards, and best practices.

• Proficiency with the Figma tool.

• Knowledge and hands-on experience with user testing and analytics tools such as UserTesting.com, Userlytics, Google Analytics, and Fullstory.

• Experience working on Design Systems with a deep understanding of the same.

• Expertise in Creative Design Ideation, creating Lo-Fi Wireframes, Hi-Fi Visual Design, clickable Prototypes, Style guides, and Design Systems for Mobile and Web apps (both consumer-facing and enterprise apps).

• Experience leading and delivering the UX in a fast-paced Agile environment.

• Strong communication skills, a team player spirit, and well-organized work priorities and deliverables.

• A passion for designing meaningful, quality User Experiences and solving problems through User-Centric Designs.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to design ownership and data-driven design decisions.

• Experience working with global teams (UX designers, Development/Engineering teams, POs/PMs, Scrum Masters, Business stakeholders).

• A strong UX work portfolio and readiness to share Figma files during interview discussions.

Responsibilities:

• Lead and own the end-to-end UX deliverables for various global initiatives.

• Drive day-to-day UX activities, including UX design reviews, deliverables planning, and Agile rituals such as Sprint and Backlog planning, and Scrum meetings.

• Capture insights by conducting User Research, analyzing data, and creating User Personas, Journeys, and Business Goals/Requirements in collaboration with the Client HCD team.

• Conduct user testing and feedback sessions to improve user experience.

• Create meaningful design ideas using storyboards, process/workflows, and Journeys based on the user research insights gathered.

• Build the required information architecture, navigation, and interactions in the UX designs.

• Lead and design UX Lo-Fi Wireframes (as needed), Hi-Fi UX Visual Designs, and Clickable UX Prototypes in Figma for all required Web/Mobile UX Designs.

• Create and maintain the required Design System, Design Components, and Libraries.

• Adhere to UX, Usability Standards & Guidelines, UX Best Practices, Accessibility Standards & Guidelines, and K-C Brand Identity Guidelines (BIG).

• Create original icons/graphics/illustrations/tables as needed for the designs and support imagery content editing/resizing.

• Prepare and present design drafts to stakeholders, lead review discussions with Business stakeholders and HCD teams, and iterate and refine UX designs.

• Actively participate in and lead user testing, analyze results and insights, and document findings.

• Update and iterate designs based on user and business feedback until approval is obtained.

• Align on design system processes for managing designs for the K-C Brand as per standards defined by the Client UX team.

• Drive UX reviews of developed UI (features/functionalities) from the UX perspective, ensure alignment with UX Designs, and report any gaps/issues to Development teams.

• Handover all UX Designs, Style guides, and related assets (Images, Icons, Copy, Graphics, etc.) to the development team.

• Work in an Agile environment with global cross-functional teams.

• Actively contribute to and measure UX and Usability Metrics for continuous optimization.

• Actively contribute in creating and sharing the strong UX case studies and success stories.

title: Especialista em Automação e Software
description:
Sobre a Gruen

Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.

Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.

Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.

Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.

Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.

Atribuições

  • Realizar projetos elétricos em plantas de energias renováveis (biogás).
  • Definir especificações técnicas do projeto.
  • Executar e supervisionar instalações internas e no cliente.
  • Definir sistemas de controle: arquitetura de rede, diagrama de interligação, lista de entradas e saídas, lista de materiais necessários para os projetos, memória de cálculo de dimensionamento de cargas e condutores.
  • Ser responsável pelo projeto elétrico completo de uma planta de biogás.
  • Auxiliar os técnicos elétricos com a montagem e/ou instalação em campo.
  • Criar e/ou adaptar software de projetos anteriores PLC e IHM (Siemens e Rockwell).
  • Realizar teste de equipamentos internamente e em fornecedores.
  • Identificar e realizar melhorias dos equipamentos.
  • Executar os startup e comissionamento dos equipamentos em conjunto com técnicos mecânicos, elétricos e outras pessoas envolvidas.
  • Ajustar e parametrizar diferentes equipamentos elétricos e eletrônicos.
  • Controlar interfaces e funcionamento de todos os módulos.
  • Realizar Interligações e controle de funcionamento em diferentes sistemas de comunicações, como: Profinet, Profibus, PA, As-Interface e outros.
  • Auxiliar o Gerente de Projeto na aprovação dos equipamentos nos fornecedores, bem como no sistema completo de purificação de biogás na planta do cliente.

Qualificações

  • Superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica, Automação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Possuir CREA ativo;
  • Conhecimento em Autocad, Eplan, programação Siemens e Rockwell.
  • Habilitação categoria B.
  • Perfil organizado, proativo, dinâmico, boa comunicação oral/escrita e com boa habilidade na resolução de conflitos.

Será visto como um diferencial:

  • Possuir certificação NR10, NR12, NR13, NR33 e NR35.
  • Possuir experiência/conhecimento com atmosfera explosivo.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens de 80-100% do tempo.

Benefícios

  • Regime de contrato CLT.
  • Salário competitivo ao do mercado.
  • Vale transporte.
  • Vale refeição (Ticket Refeição).
  • Plano de saúde.
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Seguro de vida
  • Política de viagens vantajosa e desburocratizada

title: Quality Assurance Lead
description:
MetaCTO is building next-generation developer tools powered by AI. Our mission is to streamline how technical teams design, build, and validate software—leveraging AI copilots, automation, and modern IDE extensions.

We’re seeking a Backend Engineer to help build critical infrastructure, developer integrations, and intelligent workflows from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity to work on complex technical challenges at the intersection of AI, automation, and software engineering tools.

Role Overview

As the QA Lead, you will be responsible for defining and executing the QA vision, strategy, and processes across the company. You will lead efforts to establish best practices in quality, build and mentor a team of QA engineers, and collaborate closely with engineering, product, and operations teams. This role requires both strategic thinking and hands-on involvement in automation, testing frameworks, and quality processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the company-wide QA strategy, aligning it with business and engineering goals.
  • Establish and maintain QA processes, standards, and metrics to ensure product quality and continuous improvement.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow the QA team (manual and automation engineers).
  • Collaborate with development, product, and operations teams to integrate QA into all stages of the software development lifecycle.
  • Select, implement, and maintain QA tools and automation frameworks to scale testing efficiency.
  • Own test planning, execution, and reporting for new features, releases, and regression cycles.
  • Define KPIs and quality metrics to monitor product health and team performance.
  • Drive root cause analysis and continuous feedback loops to prevent recurring issues.
  • Advocate for quality across the company, ensuring it’s embedded in culture and practices.

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a QA Lead or Senior QA Engineer in a software development environment.
  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, SDLC, and modern development practices (Agile, CI/CD, DevOps).
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, etc.).
  • Experience with performance, security, and integration testing.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to define strategy while remaining hands-on when needed.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in SaaS, cloud, or enterprise-level software.
  • Familiarity with AWS/Azure/GCP environments.
  • Knowledge of monitoring, observability, and production testing practices.
  • ISTQB or other QA/Testing certifications.

Why Join Us

Remote-first culture with a focus on autonomy and deep technical work

  • Sterilisation – Autoclaves, SIP of vessels
  • Cleaning – Parts Washer and CIP of vessels
  • Isolator (Filling, Sterility & Material Transfer isolators) - HVAC, VHP, E-Beam and Depyrogenation systems

description:

About Us

Concord isn't your typical consulting firm; we are an execution company with a passion for making things happen. Our mission is to help clients enhance customer experiences, optimize operations, and revolutionize their product offerings through seamless integration, optimization, and activation of technology and data.

We are purpose-built, merging the industry’s top specialty companies to amplify our Innovation Capabilities in analytics & AI, data management & engineering, UX and digital experience development, and technical platform integration, automation & security engineering.

About The Role

We are seeking a Lead DevOps Engineer to join our client’s Global Business Services team , where the mission is to improve and transform internal technology infrastructure, including IT operations, workplace technologies, cybersecurity, architecture, engineering services, and enterprise systems.

The Lead DevOps Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and optimizing enterprise-scale software systems and cloud platforms. This role combines deep technical expertise with leadership in DevSecOps, platform engineering, and cloud architecture.

You’ll drive innovation, ensure engineering excellence, and lead cross-functional initiatives to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing solutions. In addition to technical execution, you’ll play a key role in mentoring teams, influencing technical strategy, and integrating emerging technologies such as generative AI into engineering practices.

You’ll report to the Manager of DevSecOps Engineering and work alongside a collaborative team of engineers. As part of a global DevOps community, you’ll join a network of professionals who collaborate, support, and inspire each other while investing in continuous learning and innovation.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the design and engineering of scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise software and cloud platforms.
  • Define and implement best practices in software development, DevSecOps, and infrastructure automation.
  • Oversee deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of platforms using SRE principles.
  • Architect and manage cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) with focus on performance, cost-efficiency, and compliance.
  • Lead the development and optimization of CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.
  • Guide the adoption of containerized and serverless architectures (Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, Azure Functions).
  • Ensure adherence to security standards, conduct risk assessments, and drive compliance initiatives.
  • Translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions and roadmaps.
  • Mentor and coach engineering teams, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Explore and integrate generative AI technologies to enhance automation and software capabilities.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related technical field.
  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, DevSecOps, or platform engineering.
  • 3+ years in a technical leadership role.
  • 2+ years of experience with AI and generative AI technologies, or equivalent exposure.
  • Proven background in enterprise-scale application and infrastructure operations.
  • Advanced scripting skills (Bash, Python) for automation and infrastructure tasks.
  • Deep expertise with programming frameworks (.NET, Java) and modern application development.
  • Extensive experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, including module development.
  • Proficiency with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
  • Strong architectural knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Familiarity with SRE practices and tools for monitoring, incident management, and performance tuning.
  • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills in complex environments.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and lead teams.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Azure/AWS DevOps, PSD) are preferred.

title: Analista de Gestão de Vulnerabilidades Sr
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!

Buscamos: Analista de Gestão de Vulnerabilidades Sr

Resumo:

O Analista de Gestão de Vulnerabilidades Sênior é responsável por gerenciar ferramentas e processos de scan de vulnerabilidades. Esta função garante operações eficazes de ferramentas e processos de segurança para cobertura, detecção, avaliação, relatório e escalonamento de gerenciamento de vulnerabilidades em aplicações de negócios, infraestrutura e nuvem, coordenando a remediação com os responsáveis de tecnologia e operações.

O que você irá fazer:

  • Conduzir e executar avaliações de vulnerabilidades em endpoints, servidores, redes, aplicações e plataformas de nuvem.
  • Gerenciar e operar ferramentas de varredura de vulnerabilidades de segurança, como Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7 ou similares, e priorizar a remediação com base no risco e no impacto nos negócios.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar ferramentas e processos de Teste de Segurança de Aplicações Estáticas (SAST), Teste de Segurança de Aplicações Dinâmicas (DAST) e Análise de Composição de Software (SCA).
  • Colaborar com equipes de TI, DevOps e aplicações para garantir a integração adequada de CI/CD com remediação eficaz de vulnerabilidades.
  • Desenvolver e manter painéis e relatórios para comunicar o status das vulnerabilidades, tendências e métricas para as partes interessadas.
  • Monitorar feeds de inteligência de ameaças e correlacionar com vulnerabilidades internas para avaliar potenciais impactos para o negócio.
  • Apoiar processos de gestão de patches e validar os esforços de remediação.
  • Participar de auditorias de segurança, avaliações de conformidade e revisões de risco.
  • Melhorar continuamente os processos de gerenciamento de vulnerabilidades, automação e integrações de ferramentas.

O que buscamos?

  • Sólida experiência em operações de cibersegurança e em gerenciamento de vulnerabilidades.
  • Forte conhecimento de ferramentas de varredura de vulnerabilidades (por exemplo, Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7) e ferramentas de segurança de aplicações (por exemplo, Checkmarx, Veracode, SonarQube, Snyk).
  • Familiaridade com pontuação CVSS, modelagem de ameaças e metodologias de avaliação de risco.
  • Ótima compreensão de sistemas operacionais, redes e segurança de aplicações.
  • Conhecimento demonstrado de infraestrutura, segurança em nuvem (Azure, GCP, AWS) e frameworks de segurança (MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, etc.).
  • Forte expertise em ferramentas do Office.
  • Fluente em inglês.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Conhecimentos em scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell) será um diferencial.
  • Certificações de segurança como CISSP, CompTIA Security+, CySA+, ISO 27001, ITILv3+ ou similares.
  • Espanhol será um diferencial.

O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua

Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!

Na Kantar IBOPE Media, a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

- Provide support for employee queries using various contact methods.

- Support HRSS projects by providing administrative assistance.

Required Qualifications:

- 1+ years of experience in HR or administrative roles.

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry.

- Fluent in English and Portuguese (spoken and written).

- Excellent organizational and communication skills.

- Ability to follow standardized procedures and manage tasks in a high volume environment.

- Proficiency in HRIS systems (e.g., SAP, HCM), case management tools, and Microsoft Office Suite.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Familiarity with LATAM labor laws and HR compliance standards.

title: Professor de português (gramática e redação)
description:
A empresa
GS Aprova nasceu com a missão de transformar vidas por meio da educação. Hoje oferecemos preparação completa para vestibulares como ENEM, FUVEST e outros exames, com foco em Matemática, Redação e acompanhamento personalizado que ajuda cada estudante a vencer suas maiores dificuldades. Mas esse é só o começo. Estamos ampliando nosso escopo para atender de forma ainda mais completa nossos públicos: alunos que querem aprovação em universidades de ponta, jovens que sonham com concursos públicos e famílias que buscam uma formação sólida para seus filhos. Por isso, estamos em busca de pessoas inspiradas e apaixonadas por ensinar, que desejam se tornar parte do time que construiu e investiu no GS Aprova. Nossa proposta é clara: o modelo de remuneração estará diretamente ligado ao crescimento da plataforma, para que cada conquista também seja compartilhada com quem faz parte dessa jornada. Se você acredita no poder da educação para transformar a sociedade e quer crescer junto com a gente, o GS Aprova é o seu lugar. A vaga GS Aprova está crescendo e busca um(a) Professor(a) de Português que queira ir além do modelo tradicional de ensino. Não se trata apenas de dar aulas, mas de criar experiências de aprendizagem que inspiram e transformam. Você será responsável por: Produzir conteúdo em diferentes formatos (aulas particulares, materiais digitais, posts, roteiros para vídeos e aulas na plataforma). Assumir a frente de Gramática e Redação, desenvolvendo trilhas de estudo que conectem teoria e prática. Atender alunos individualmente, personalizando o ensino de acordo com suas necessidades e objetivos. supervisionar correção das redações com feedback crítico e construtivo. Participar da construção pedagógica da plataforma, trazendo visão sistêmica e crítica para evoluir o projeto. O que esperamos de você: Paixão por ensinar e disposição para inovar no formato das aulas. Comunicação clara e empática, com habilidade de relacionamento com alunos e famílias. Experiência comprovada em ensino de Português, especialmente Gramática e Redação. Capacidade de adaptar conteúdos a diferentes níveis de proficiência. Formação em Letras, Pedagogia ou áreas correlatas (diferencial). Fluência em outros idiomas será vista como um plus. Nosso modelo de remuneração está atrelado ao crescimento da plataforma, ou seja, cada vitória do GS Aprova também será sua. Procuramos pessoas inspiradas, que queiram se tornar parte do time que está construindo e investindo no futuro da educação.

title: Java React Developer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in React.js on the frontend and Java Spring Boot on the backend. The ideal candidate will have experience designing, developing, and deploying scalable web applications, integrating APIs, and working with relational databases like PostgreSQL . This role requires not only technical proficiency but also a problem-solving mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in an Agile/Scrum environment. Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes is a strong plus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain highly responsive web applications using React.js, Java Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL.
  • Build scalable backend services and RESTful APIs, ensuring performance, security, and reliability.
  • Implement reusable UI components and follow best practices in frontend development with React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Optimize database queries and manage schemas using PostgreSQL and ORM frameworks (JPA/Hibernate).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, UI/UX designers, and QA engineers to deliver high-quality features.
  • Participate in the full SDLC (software development lifecycle), from requirements gathering to deployment and support.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing applications.
  • Follow Agile best practices, including participation in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
  • Contribute to code reviews to ensure high coding standards and maintainability.
  • (Nice to Have) Support deployment and DevOps activities including containerization with Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes .

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong experience in React.js , JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Hands-on expertise in Java Spring Boot for backend development.
  • Experience in RESTful API design and development .
  • Proficiency in PostgreSQL and ORM frameworks like JPA/Hibernate .
  • Solid understanding of Git version control and branching strategies.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and working in cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Docker for containerization and Kubernetes for orchestration.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks for frontend (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library) and backend (e.g., JUnit).

title: Digital Performance Manager - Google Ads
description:
The Role: 

Are you a digital optimist with a passion for defining search strategies on a global scale? A Google Campaign Manager, you will be responsible for driving our regional Always On Search Strategy across our different markets, optimizing performance and KPIs through your expertise in Google products and marketing analytics. Working collaboratively with cross-functional teams (Brand, Trade Marketing, Digital, etc. ), you will define priorities, drive traffic and support local markets with creative, data-driven media solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to help shape our digital presence, build bridges across teams and drive growth as we continue to scale out our search strategy to new markets throughout 2026.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Lead the brand’s paid search strategy to drive results in Google Ads (Search, other campaign types) and contribute to digital KPIs.
  • Work with digital and media managers to educate and align stakeholders in order to define successful media strategies.
  • Own implementation, optimization and monitoring of campaigns and establishing best practices in order to test and drive continuous improvement in testing and analytics.
  • Present strategy and campaign performance to executives, ensuring alignment around KPIs and marketing objectives.
  • Work with agencies and analytics teams for campaign setup, tracking and performance measurement.

Qualifications: 

  • Strong strategic insight, data analysis and optimization skills, with a track record of multi-platform performance measurement and attribution.
  • Experience managing Always On Search Campaigns. 
  • A history of delivering improved marketing efficiencies and better ROI/ROAS across international markets.
  • Advanced ability to interpret media metrics and deliver actionable insights for paid and unpaid digital activity.
  • Solid track record of agency management experience and working within global, matrixed organizations.
  • Deep knowledge of and commitment to understanding brand fundamentals and insights management.
  • Proficiency in Google Ads, Search Ads 360, Google Analytics, Amazon AMS, third party measurement tools with an understanding of advanced bidding and automation.
  • Creative, proactive, and detail-oriented team player with a consumer-centric, results-driven mentality.
  • Proven experience planning and managing integrated, cross-channel campaigns in both agency or in-house environments.

What You Will Get in Return 

A competitive salary and compensation package, with flexibility to manage personal commitments. The chance to help build a world-class function, working with trusted brands that touch everyday life and business around the world. Meaningful work and opportunities for growth if you are looking for both challenge and connection.

title: Business Development Lead (LATAM)
description:
Gambling.com Group (Nasdaq: GAMB) is a multi-award winning provider of marketing and sports data services looking for exceptional talent interested in the fast-paced, high-growth online gambling industry. The company operates a portfolio of renowned websites and brands – including flagship site Gambling.com and sports betting site Bookies.com as well as iGaming-focused sites Casinos.com, BonusFinder.com and UK-centric Freebets.com. In the U.S., the company operates state-specific websites such as NewYorkBets.com, BetCarolina.com, and BetArizona.com, helping consumers discover and connect with legal gambling options.

In addition to its marketing operations, Gambling.com Group provides sports data services through consumer subscription platforms like OddsJam and RotoWire, along with B2B services through OpticOdds. These offerings deliver real-time data, actionable insights, and technology driven tools to both consumers and enterprise partners.

As the first and only online gambling affiliate publicly traded in the U.S., Gambling.com Group has earned recognition as a leader in its field – most recently winning Casino Affiliate of the Year at the 2024 EGR Operator Awards. Gambling.com Group embraces a majority remote-first hybrid work model, offering employees the flexibility to work remotely while being part of a global team. For some roles, in-office presence is required for operational reasons, ensuring seamless collaboration and effectiveness where needed. With flagship offices in Dublin, Charlotte, and Malta, and satellite offices in Madison, Helsinki, Serbia, and Costa Rica, we operate on a "think local, act global" mindset. Gambling.com Group is on the lookout for innovative, solution-driven, and fast-paced thinkers to join our growing team.

Are you ready to take the next step in your career?

At OpticOdds, we’re transforming how companies trade and manage risk in the sports betting industry. We provide real-time sports betting data and risk management solutions that help clients boost profitability while saving thousands of engineering hours. We’ve simplified real-time data and made it more accessible and actionable for sportsbooks, exchanges, and platforms.

Our product is strong. Our traction is real. Now, we’re looking to expand our small, fast-moving team to keep up with explosive growth. That’s where you come in.

As our first Central America Account Executive, you will be responsible for driving OpticOdds’ commercial growth across the region. The focus is on building new business opportunities, developing strategic operator relationships, and expanding accounts over time.

This role requires ownership of the full sales cycle: identifying opportunities, engaging with clients, managing negotiations, and ensuring long-term success with signed operators. Success will come from strong industry connections, sharp commercial instincts, and the ability to represent OpticOdds effectively both at industry events and in direct client engagements.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the full sales cycle with clients, from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close.
  • Develop a balanced pipeline by sourcing outbound opportunities and converting inbound leads.
  • Expand OpticOdds’ footprint across Central and South America with a focus on enterprise sportsbooks while also engaging emerging operators.
  • Deliver clear, compelling presentations to clients at all levels of an organization, both in-person and remotely.
  • Listen actively to client needs and translate those into actionable feedback for the product and engineering teams.
  • Monitor regulatory changes, competitor activity, and operator strategies, and use those insights to strengthen OpticOdds’ positioning.
  • Represent OpticOdds at industry events and conferences to build visibility and credibility in the region.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data in the CRM with clear prioritization and forecasting.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to refine messaging, improve collateral, and align commercial strategy with product direction.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of B2B sales experience in the sports betting industry.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed aggressive revenue targets.
  • Strong network within sportsbooks and operators in Central and South America.
  • Fluency in Spanish and Portuguese strongly preferred.
  • Experience running a SaaS sales process independently, from prospecting through closing.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with credibility in conversations with senior operator stakeholders.
  • Proficient with CRMs and confident in building and presenting proposals.
  • Self-starter who thrives in high-growth, unstructured environments.

Perks & Benefits

title: JAMS Automation Engineer
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.

The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. This role will be responsible for automating repeatable processes in Sompo’s public cloud and on-premise datacenter environments to improve process efficiencies. This role will be responsible for developing, documenting, maintaining, supporting, and optimizing automation workflows. Subject matter expertise is required in Microsoft PowerShell scripting.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop, test and validate PowerShell scripts as part of automation workflows and maintain in source control for change management.

• Create and Maintain a Dynamic Inventory of all JAMS Scheduler Jobs.

• Create and maintain a JAMS incident tracker for logging dates and times of all warnings and errors from JAMS Scheduler Jobs as well as escalation and fix details.

• Update Job properties (Schedules, Source Code etc.) as directed by Job owners.

• Proactively review and monitor the health of all JAMS Jobs i.e. daily reviewing output of all jobs.

• Review job failures and take corrective action where possible or escalate to Job owner as necessary.

• Log Service Desk ticket (incident) for all JAMS Scheduler Job failures, provide resolution in collaboration with job owner and maintain incident resolution log\ knowledge base.

• Installation of JAMS Client tools, JAMS software updates and\or reporting tools.

• Liaise with JAMS account representative and Sompo procurement in relation to JAMS Scheduler annual support License renewals.

• Participate in IT projects, responsible for development of automation workflows outlined in the Project Plan and directed by the Project Manager, at whatever level of effort or participation has been defined for them.

• Build, administer, monitor and maintain JAMS Enterprise Scheduler and System Center Orchestrator environments.

• Work with Application team members to evaluate automation workflow needs and requirements.

• Develop integrations between infrastructure systems for data analysis and reporting through REST API calls.

• Maintain JAMS platform, standard operating procedures, perform changes, apply patches, and updates as required.

• Prevent, diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve automation runbook errors.

• Maintain strict change control of the automation infrastructure.

• Continuously identify and report areas of improvement in the automation arena and implement improvements when approved.

• Contribute to on-going research and evaluation of new technologies.

• Responsible for completing other work requirements or tasks that are requested by IT management when necessary to meet the goals and objectives of the department or company.

• Working continuously on a task until completion to ensure business automation workflows remain available 24/7.

• The ability to multitask while ensuring the highest quality of work is maintained.

• Establishing a good working relationship with customers and other IT groups.

• Be able to work independently within established policies and procedures.

• Perform routine tasks unsupervised.

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS

• Excellent technical skills including however not limited to Microsoft Operating systems server including PowerShell scripting, Microsoft SQL Server , Microsoft Azure including Logic Apps, JSON Scripting, REST API.

• Azure or AWS Certification is desirable.

• Experience with System Center Orchestrator 2012 or later preferred.

• Experience with JAMS Enterprise Manager is highly desirable and preferred.

GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong background in an Infrastructure environment with a minimum of 5 years’ experience.

• Team orientated with the ability to multitask and prioritize workloads.

• Very strong problem solving and analytical skills and is a systemic thinker with an attention to detail.

• Seeks to expand knowledge and experience and is committed to continuous learning.

Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

title: Coordenador de Canais e Parcerias
description:
A Aliare é uma das principais empresas de software para o agronegócio no Brasil. Com raízes no setor, somos especialistas em oferecer soluções tecnológicas para a gestão de empresas e propriedades rurais.

Estamos ao lado de nossos clientes, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do campo e ajudando a construir o presente e o futuro do agronegócio.

Atualmente, buscamos um profissional para liderar e desenvolver a equipe de canais e parcerias do myFarm. Este coordenador será responsável por implementar estratégias para expandir a presença da marca no mercado, prospectar e gerenciar novos parceiros estratégicos, garantir alta performance e alinhamento com as metas de crescimento, além de capacitar e engajar os parceiros para impulsionar as vendas e resultados.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Liderar e desenvolver a equipe responsável pelos canais, garantindo alinhamento estratégico e alta performance.
  • Desenvolver e implementar a estratégia de canais para ampliar a presença do myFarm no mercado.
  • Identificar, prospectar e selecionar novos parceiros estratégicos (revendas, consultorias, distribuidores, cooperativas, entre outros).
  • Conduzir o processo de recrutamento, negociação e onboarding de parceiros comerciais.
  • Definir metas de crescimento e acompanhar indicadores de performance dos canais.
  • Construir e manter um relacionamento sólido com os parceiros, garantindo engajamento e alinhamento estratégico.
  • Atuar como ponto focal para os parceiros, garantindo suporte e promovendo ações que impulsionem os resultados de vendas
  • Implementar e gerenciar um programa de benefícios para os parceiros, incentivando a performance e retenção.
  • Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos comerciais e técnicos para capacitação dos parceiros.
  • Criar materiais de apoio e playbooks para auxiliar os parceiros na abordagem e vendas da solução.
  • Acompanhar e atualizar os parceiros sobre as evoluções do myFarm, garantindo que estejam sempre alinhados com as melhores práticas e novidades da solução.
  • Estruturar processos para qualificação, ativação e acompanhamento dos parceiros.
  • Criar e monitorar KPIs do canal, como receita gerada, taxa de conversão, engajamento dos parceiros e churn.
  • Elaborar relatórios e análises periódicas para apresentação dos resultados e identificação de oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de marketing, vendas e sucesso do cliente para garantir alinhamento nas ações de crescimento e engajamento dos canais.
  • Contribuir com insights e feedbacks dos parceiros para otimização da oferta e roadmap do produto.
  • Acompanhar tendências de mercado e concorrência para aprimoramento contínuo da estratégia de canais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Liderança: Gerenciar e desenvolver a equipe, estabelecendo estratégias voltadas a atingir determinadas objetivos.
  • Negociação: Dialogar e encontrar soluções que satisfaçam a todos os envolvidos, conciliando diversas opiniões e interesses.
  • Comunicação eficaz: Fazer-se entender de maneira clara e precisa, de forma contextualizada e compreensível para o outro.
  • Tomada de decisão: Analisar problemas e todas as variáveis envolvidas e tomar decisões assertivas e focadas em resultados.
  • Adaptabilidade: Adaptar-se a diferentes cenários ou circunstâncias.
  • Resiliência: Reagir de forma positiva e produtiva diante de pressões, frustrações e fortes impactos emocionais.
  • Criatividade: Facilidade para
  • encontrar novas ideias para solucionar problemas.
  • Foco em resultado: Conduzir os processos de modo a atingir os resultados esperados.
  • Experiência em gestão de canais e parcerias – Vivência na estruturação, prospecção e gestão de parceiros comerciais.
  • Conhecimento em vendas consultivas e B2B – Experiência com vendas de software (preferencialmente SaaS) e negociação de parcerias estratégicas.
  • Familiaridade com o mercado do agronegócio – Desejável experiência no setor agro ou conhecimento sobre gestão de propriedades rurais.
  • Habilidade com indicadores e métricas – Capacidade de estruturar e monitorar KPIs como CAC, LTV, conversão e engajamento de parceiros.
  • Gestão de CRM e ferramentas de automação – Experiência com plataformas como HubSpot, Piperun ou similares.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver treinamentos e materiais de capacitação – Experiência em criação de apresentações, playbooks e webinars para parceiros.
  • Conhecimento básico de marketing de canais – Noções de estratégias de co-marketing, campanhas de incentivo e geração de demanda via parceiros.
  • Domínio de metodologias comerciais

title: Integration Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced AWS API Integration Engineer to lead the migration of existing MuleSoft integrations to Amazon Web Services (AWS). You will design, build, and optimize API and event-driven integration solutions leveraging AWS-native services, ensuring secure, scalable, and cost-efficient architectures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Migrate existing MuleSoft integrations to AWS-based solutions.
  • Design, develop, and deploy APIs (REST, GraphQL) and event-driven workflows using AWS services including:
  • Amazon API Gateway
  • AWS Lambda
  • AWS Step Functions
  • Amazon EventBridge
  • Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) / Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS)
  • Implement robust security and access control using AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM), API keys, and authentication/authorization frameworks (OAuth2, JWT).
  • Optimize integrations for performance, scalability, maintainability, and cost.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (architects, developers, DevOps) to ensure seamless deployment and integration.
  • Provide technical documentation, code reviews, and best practice guidance.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in systems integration or backend development.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS integration services (API Gateway, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS/SNS).
  • Solid understanding of RESTful and GraphQL API design principles.
  • Experience with event-driven and serverless architectures.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Node.js, or Java preferred).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (AWS CloudFormation, Terraform, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of API security best practices and authentication standards.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
